name: Florida FFA
what_you_do: FFA goes with your farm and food class. Members join chapter events, contests, leadership camps and the state convention.
who_can_apply: Students enrolled in an agriculture course at their school. Joining a chapter in a nearby school district is a state and local decision.
pay_detail: National dues $7 per year plus state dues $10 per year. Local chapters may add dues.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join through your school's agriculture class.
how_to_apply: Ask your school counselor or agriculture teacher to enroll you in an agriculture course. Use the Chapter Locator on the site.
notes: For overnight events, an advisor or an adult your school approves must come with students. You also need a permission form and a medical form. Event fees pay for lodging and meals at most events.
